title: Run the Runbook
story: The day shift left a tiny health-report script. Reading it is wise, but the night dashboard will stay blank until someone actually runs it.
objective: Run /workspace/publish-health.sh so it creates /reports/health.txt with the expected ready status.
hints: Read publish-health.sh before running it so you know what it changes.
sh can execute a readable shell script even when it is not marked executable.
explanation: Small scripts turn repeatable command sequences into reusable tools. Inspect unfamiliar scripts first, then run them with sh or grant a suitable executable mode and invoke them directly.
